title: chezmoi DNS filtering
description: Shape of .chezmoidata/dns.yaml. Fleet-wide: one policy for every client. Whether a host runs the filter is placement -- the `blocky` quadlet in .chezmoidata/hosts.yaml.

upstream.description: The resolver behind the filter. Read by blocky's upstream and by CoreDNS's fallback, so both use the same one.

servername.description: TLS name for DoT. One value for every ip -- CoreDNS's forward takes a single tls_servername per stanza.

filter.description: Host-side ports blocky publishes on loopback. Its in-container listeners stay on the image's 53 and 4000.

api_port.description: HTTP API port. Unauthenticated and carries a blocking kill-switch, so it is published on 127.0.0.1 only.

blocklists.description: Hosts-format URLs. loading.strategy is failOnError, so one unreachable list keeps blocky down rather than filtering half of this.
